_comment: Operator-maintained instrument events that no data file reports (Vaisala CL31/CL51 L1 carry the placeholder serial CL0, so an optical-block replacement is invisible). Key = <wmo>_<ident>; date = UTC day of the change; label = what changed. Shown as markers on the station C_L time series. Unit swaps under the same ident (CL31 -> CL51: range gates 770 -> 1540) were found by validation/v23_release/scan_type_changes.py in the v2.3 release comparison.

0-20000-0-06610_B.label: CL31 optical block replaced (C_L step x2.8)

0-20000-0-11450_A.label: CL31 replaced by a CL51 (range 7.7 -> 15.4 km); L1 type attribute updated 2025-10-09; whole record calibrated as CL51 in v2.3

0-20000-0-11438_A.label: CL31 replaced by a CL51 (range 7.7 -> 15.4 km); L1 type attribute updated 2026-07-03; whole record calibrated as CL51 in v2.3
